## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector participation but major tech divergence (MSFT (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -8.05% | 1M: +9.39%) CORRECTION) and concentrated leadership (Leadership: Narrow — Industrials 3/5 in Top 5); style tilt toward Value/Cyclical.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**

Communication/Telecom strong: T (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +10.38%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +4.46%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing pockets of strength: SLB (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +8.67%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: GOOGL (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) CORRECTION. Consumer Discretionary contains outliers: TSLA (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: GM (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND, MMM (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +7.43%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +10.38%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (Industrials 3/5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -2.40%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -8.99% | 1M: +8.27%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -8.05% | 1M: +9.39%) CORRECTION, AMZN (1W: -7.44% | 1M: +1.93%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in select high-multiple names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: GM (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND; watch recovery signals such as NUE (1W: +7.42% | 1M: -0.17%) RECOVERY and major divergences in big tech (MSFT, NVDA, META) signalling tactical uncertainty.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed and vulnerable to profit-taking: AAPL (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +22.45%) ABOVE TREND but MSFT (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND; Technology is the only sector negative on the week (sector 1W: -1.32%).

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive: JPM (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +6.77%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +9.68%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +11.78%) ABOVE TREND — Financials are participating in the broader advance and support a Value/Cyclical tilt.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mostly steady/defensive: JNJ (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +6.19%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +0.51%) CORRECTION — sector showing positive weekly breadth overall.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Value/Cyclicals and select Industrials and Energy names (e.g., LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +4.32% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to stretched tech names showing CORRECTION (GOOGL, MSFT, NVDA, META) and monitor TSLA (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%) BELOW TREND for risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed (+80); UNH (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +0.51%) CORRECTION — earnings/backlash mix to monitor (+85 news); V (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +9.68%) ABOVE TREND (+65). BEARISH: TMUS (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -2.40%) BELOW TREND (-50 news outage), INTC (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%) BELOW TREND (-50), GOOGL (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +3.25%) broad leadership, Energy (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +12.15%) showing carry. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.32% | 1M: +0.71%) where weekly selling and CORRECTION patterns in large caps warrant monitoring; Communication mixed due to TMUS outage versus T strength.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch AAPL (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +22.45%) for continuation above its 1M strength; MSFT (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%) needs weekly stabilization to avoid deeper CORRECTION; NVDA (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%) must reclaim short-term momentum to confirm any recovery; JPM (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +6.77%) breakout continuation would support cyclicals.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
RTX (+80): RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND — news and price confirming. UNH (+85): UNH (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +0.51%) CORRECTION — strong print but short-term pullback, watch follow-through. V (+65): V (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +9.68%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
TMUS (-50): TMUS (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -2.40%) BELOW TREND — outage news confirming downside. INTC (-50): INTC (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%) BELOW TREND — downgrade and price weakness aligned. XOM (-50): XOM (1W: +4.32% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND — analyst caution divergent from price, monitor for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Value/Cyclical tilt. LMT (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%) ABOVE TREND, RTX (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) ABOVE TREND and GM (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is concentrated tech divergence (MSFT, NVDA, META CORRECTION) and mixed sentiment (XOM negative news vs price) — monitor for confirmation before shifting beta.
